Why Traditional Investment Newsletters Fail Retail Traders

Most retail investors start their journey by subscribing to traditional monthly or quarterly investment newsletters. While some of these publications offer decent foundational education, they suffer from a fatal flaw: the time lag.

By the time a stock recommendation is researched, written, edited, formatted, printed, and mailed (or emailed) to subscribers, days or even weeks have passed. In fast-moving equity and options markets, a delay of 48 hours can mean missing the ideal entry price entirely. Furthermore, traditional publishers often keep subscribers in the dark once the pick is made, leaving them stranded when market conditions shift unexpectedly.

Active trading and smart long-term investing require agility, peer-to-peer brainstorming, and—most importantly—near real-time updates from someone whose own skin is actually in the game. That realization is what drove Bill Spetrino to launch an independent interactive platform where communication flows freely on an intra-day basis.

The B.I.O. Forum is an exclusive, highly curated online community designed for investors and traders of all experience levels.
